title: Neurovascular coupling in the basolateral amygdala modulates negative emotions.
summary: Emotion induces changes in regional cerebral blood flow, a manifestation of neurovascular coupling (NVC). However, whether NVC provides feedback to actively modulate emotion remains unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that NVC actively and bidirectionally modulates stress-induced negative emotions. We established bidirectional manipulations of NVC in freely moving mice by employing integrated pharmacological, genetic, and arteriolar optogenetic approaches. Our results showed that both systemic and region-specific NVC deficiencies in the basolateral amygdala (BLA) heightened emotional responses when mice transitioned from a safe, familiar environment to anxiogenic environments and that local restoration of NVC in the BLA normalized these responses. Mechanistically, NVC dysfunction impaired the capacity of BLA neuronal scaling during state transitions, manifesting as a characteristic biphasic pattern of c-Fos topology. NVC-deficient animals aberrantly adopted high-stress configurations under mild stress but regressed to low-stress templates during high-demand survival threats, thereby compromising defensive sustainability. Notably, the genetic NVC-enhancement model counteracted NVC impairments caused by chronic stress, thereby alleviating stress-driven emotional distress. These findings establish NVC in the BLA as an allostatic program that fine-tunes neural circuit activity during emotional responses, with implications for understanding and treating emotional disorders.

标题：基底外侧杏仁核的神经血管耦合调节负性情绪  
摘要：情绪会引发区域性脑血流变化，这是神经血管耦合（NVC）的表现。然而，NVC是否提供反馈以主动调节情绪仍有待探索。在此，我们证明NVC能主动且双向地调节应激诱导的负性情绪。我们通过整合药理学、遗传学和微动脉光学遗传学方法，在自由活动小鼠中建立了NVC的双向调控。结果显示，当小鼠从安全熟悉的环境转换到致焦虑环境时，基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）中系统性及区域特异性的NVC缺陷均会增强情绪反应，而局部恢复BLA中的NVC可使这些反应正常化。机制上，NVC功能障碍损害了BLA神经元在状态转换期间的缩放能力，表现为c-Fos拓扑结构的特征性双相模式。NVC缺陷动物在轻度应激下异常采用高应激配置，但在高需求生存威胁时退化为低应激模板，从而削弱防御可持续性。值得注意的是，遗传性NVC增强模型可抵消慢性应激引起的NVC损伤，从而缓解应激驱动的情绪困扰。这些发现确立了BLA中的NVC作为一种动态适应程序，在情绪反应期间精细调节神经回路活动，对理解和治疗情绪障碍具有启示意义。  
关键词：神经血管耦合；基底外侧杏仁核；负性情绪；应激；情绪调节
